title: Alcumus Achievements
text: Focus on Fractions: Use the frac notation to correctly answer a question. XP reward: 20 Rambunctious Radicals: Use the sqrt notation to correctly answer a question. XP reward: 20 Stuck in the Middle: Correctly answer a question using the interval notation. XP reward: 20 Life of Pi: Correctly answer a question in terms of pi. XP reward: 31 All for Naught: Correctly answer a question where the answer is 0. XP reward: 20 Eek! Gross!: Correctly answer a question where the answer is 144. XP reward: 44 Slayer: Correctly answer a level 25 problem on your first try. XP reward: 25 Busy Bee I/II/III: Correctly answer 100/200/300 problems in one week. XP reward: 25/50/75 Never Gonna Give You Up I/II/III: Answer 200/500/1000 problems in a row without ever hitting the give up button. XP reward: 40/80/120 Sharpshooter I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Accuracy. XP reward: 50/100 Brute I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Power. XP reward: 50/100 Made of Iron I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Resilience. XP reward: 50/100 Juggernaut I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Stamina. XP reward: 50/100 Archimedes I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Prealgebra. XP reward: 25/50 al-Khwarizmi I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Algebra. XP reward: 50/100 Gauss I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Number Theory. XP reward: 50/100 Pascal I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Counting and Probability. XP reward: 50/100 Euclid I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Geometry. XP reward: 50/100 Euler I/II: Reach level 10/25 in Intermediate Algebra. XP reward: 70/140 Erdos I/II: Reach an overall level of 10/25. XP reward: 125/250 Triple Double: Reach level 10 in three different subjects. XP reward: 20 There is a prize for this: Gain two overall levels without completing any quests or achievements. XP reward: 200 Prealgebra Victory: Pass all topics in Prealgebra. XP reward: 50 Algebra Victory: Pass all topics in Algebra. XP reward: 80 Number Theory Victory: Pass all topics in Number Theory. XP reward: 80 Counting Victory: Pass all topics in Counting and Probability. XP reward: 80 Geometry Victory: Pass all topics in Geometry. XP reward: 80 Intermediate Algebra Victory: Pass all topics in Intermediate Algebra. XP reward: 100 Total Victory: Pass all topics in all subjects. XP reward: 250 Prealgebra Master: Master all topics in Prealgebra. XP reward: 75 Algebra Master: Master all topics in Algebra. XP reward: 150 Number Theory Master: Master all topics in Number Theory. XP reward: 150 Counting Master: Master all topics in Counting and Probability. XP reward: 150 Geometry Master: Master all topics in Geometry. XP reward: 150 Intermediate Algebra Master: Master all topics in Intermediate Algebra. XP reward: 200 Alcumus Grandmaster: Master all topics in all subjects. XP reward: 400 Best Week Ever: Top a weekly hall of fame list. XP reward: 50 All Time Great: Appear on the all-time hall of fame list. XP reward: 125 Johnny Quest: Complete three different quests that were all assigned and completed in a 24 hour period. XP reward: 33 Legendary: Complete a 5 star quest. XP reward: 25 Quest Master I/II/II: Complete 25/50/75 different quests. XP reward: 25/50/75 Overachiever I/II/III: Obtain 25/50/75 achievements. XP reward: 50/100/150 Catch 22: Correctly answer a level 22 problem on the first try. XP reward: 22 Conspiracy Theory: Input "illuminati" as the answer to a problem. XP reward: 50 Deja vu: Correctly answer a problem that you've done before. XP reward: 10 Fully Charged: Completely fill the XP Bonus meter. XP reward: 25 Indecisive: Change your focus topic for five consecutive problems. XP reward: 25 James Bond: Correctly answer a problem at 0:07 on the hour. XP reward: 7 Life, the Universe, and Everything: Input "42" as the answer to a problem. XP reward: 42 Perseverance: Correctly answer 10 problems on the second attempt without any incorrect second attempts in between. XP reward: 50 Richard: Input "richard" as the answer to a problem. XP reward: 50 Thanks for the help!: Have an Alcumus error report validated. XP reward: 25 Them Internets: Correctly answer a question with an answer equal to the last number of the player's IP address. XP reward: 5 Triskaidekaphobia: On Friday, input "13" as the answer to a problem. XP reward: 13 Amnesia: Get a problem wrong that you previously solved correctly. XP reward: -1 Aren't you a bit old for this?: Master all topics in a non-Prealgebra subject, then pass a Prealgebra topic for the first time. XP reward: 25 Caution: Hard Hat Area: Visit Alcumus while it was shut down for maintenance. XP reward: 0 Chicken?: Give up on 100 problems. XP reward: -1 Double Trouble: Try the same wrong answer twice. XP reward: 2 Early Bird: Be the first to solve a problem in a given day. XP reward: 0 j00 r t3h 1337: Correctly answer a problem at 13:37 server time. XP reward: 37 Just Guessing: Get a problem wrong by using 0 as your second guess. XP reward: 0 Pick Your Poison: Miss your first problem after changing focus topics. XP reward: -1 Rage-quit: Leave Alcumus for 12 hours after getting a problem wrong. XP reward: -1 Super Secret!: You are not sure how you received this honor. (Correctly answer a problem when the time is AB:CD:EF, and the answer was CDEF, the variables representing digits.) XP reward: 100 Superstitious: Answer 7 on a problem whose answer was 13. XP reward: 7 Ub3r 1337: Correctly answer a problem at the 37th second of the 13th minute. XP reward: 133
